hero_body: Keep the moments. Remember the voices.
empty_body: Add a memory to begin your family journal.
title: Title
no_albums_body: Create an album, then add memories to it.
delete_memory: Delete this memory and its attachments?
delete_album: Delete this album? Its memories will stay in your library.
delete_attachment: Delete this attachment from your device?
delete_book: Delete this scrapbook draft? Your memories will stay safe.
delete_all: Delete all local memories, albums, recordings and scrapbook drafts? This cannot be undone.
recording_notice: Audio stays on this device. Leaving the app stops and saves this recording. Free recordings are limited to three minutes.
microphone_notice: LifeTalea needs microphone access only while you record or use push-to-talk. You can always write instead.
microphone_denied: Microphone access was declined. You can still write a story or add photographs.
recording_failed: Recording could not be saved. Check microphone access and free storage, then try again.
operation_failed: That did not finish. Check the file, permissions and available storage, then try again. Your existing memories are unchanged.
transcription_unavailable: Audio transcription is not configured in this build. Your recording is safe. You can type or paste a transcript below.
transcription_notice: Create a draft from this recording on your device. No audio is uploaded. Choose the spoken language, then confirm. Recordings up to ten minutes are supported. Processing may be slow; check the draft for mistakes before saving.
transcription_failed: This recording could not be transcribed. Try again, or enter a transcript yourself.
transcription_empty: No clear speech was detected. Try a clearer recording or enter the words yourself.
transcription_limit: Transcribe recordings up to ten minutes long. Longer recordings are safe and can have a manually entered transcript.
transcription_consent_required: Confirm on-device processing before starting transcription.
voice_notice: Push to talk uses your device’s speech service, which may need internet and process speech externally. Only continue if you agree. Audio commands are not saved by LifeTalea. Command phrases currently support English.
voice_unavailable: Speech recognition is unavailable on this device. Use the touch controls or type a command.
voice_error: Speech was not recognised. Try again or use the text command field.
unknown_command: Try: Create a new memory, Open my timeline, or Create a keepsake book.
tts_unavailable: Spoken audio is unavailable for this language or device. Your written story is still available.
prompt_childhood: What childhood memory still makes you smile?
prompt_tradition: What family tradition would you like to preserve?
prompt_lesson: What advice would you give your younger self?
prompt_recipe: Which family recipe has a story behind it?
no_results: No memories found. Try another search or filter.
no_books_body: Bring saved memories together in a scrapbook. Arrange pages, add captions and keep a draft.
caption: Page caption
pdf_note: PDF generation happens on your device. Review the file before sharing. Recordings are not embedded in printed keepsakes.
empty_book: Add a memory to create the first page.
missing_memory: This memory has been deleted. Remove this page or choose another memory.
welcome: Make space for the stories that matter.
welcome_body: A private home for photographs, voices and family memories. No account required. Your memories stay on this device unless you choose to export them.
language_note: Choose a language or follow your device settings. Development translations still need native-language review. Your stories are not translated.
purpose: What would you like to preserve?
privacy_body: Memories and attachments are stored privately on this device. There are no advertising or analytics SDKs. Android system backup is disabled. Deleting the app removes its local data. Keep a backup somewhere safe. Speech recognition is provided by your installed service; review its privacy settings. Amazon purchasing communicates with Amazon. LifeTalea does not upload memories or recordings.
backup_notice: Stories, transcripts, albums and scrapbook drafts are included. Photos and recordings are included only when selected. Unencrypted exports contain readable private information. Keep your passphrase safe; it cannot be recovered. Current archive limits: 32 MiB total and 16 MiB per attachment. Larger libraries need a future streaming backup implementation.
restore_notice: Choose a LifeTalea backup. Passphrase is needed only for encrypted files. Existing memories and drafts are kept on conflicts.
restore_counts: Memories: %1$d · Albums: %2$d · Attachments: %3$d · Scrapbooks: %4$d · Existing memories kept: %5$d
premium_body: One purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, keepsake PDF exports and encrypted local backups. Your existing memories always stay accessible.
free_limits: Free: three albums, photographs, written stories, timeline and recordings up to three minutes. No limit on saved written memories.
billing_unconfigured: Purchases are unavailable: Amazon app authentication and product configuration are not installed. No payment will be taken.
billing_unavailable: Amazon product details are unavailable. Try again later.
purchase_failed: Purchase or restore did not complete. No new Premium access was granted.
album_limit: The free tier includes three albums. Upgrade to create more.
invalid_form: Add a title and a valid date matching the selected precision.
support_body: Publisher: O.Bankole · Support: banksmi@mail.com · Build 0.1.0 development preview. Export a backup before uninstalling. For microphone issues, check device permissions. Source: github.com/lanray07/LifeTalea
finish_recording: Stop the active recording before changing memories.
backup_busy: Please wait for the current operation to finish.
new_page: Choose a memory for this page
record_first: Create or open a memory before recording.
no_story: Open a saved story to read it aloud.
save_first: Save your story before adding attachments.
reminders_pending: Reminders are not implemented in this development build.
search_year_hint: YYYY or blank for every year
purchase_privacy: Amazon purchases send app-specific Amazon user and receipt identifiers to LifeTalea’s Supabase-hosted verifier and Amazon. Providers may retain request and connection logs. Stories, photos and recordings are not sent for verification. Saved-recording transcription runs on this device. Exported files must be deleted separately.
reminder_notice: Optional daily reminder around 20:00 local time. Delivery may be delayed by device settings. Notifications contain no story content. Off by default.
reminder_unavailable: Notifications are unavailable. Check this app’s notification permission and channel in device settings.
